title: Principal Architect - ReactNative
description:
JD for SME \- Reactnative Architecture
   

  

 At Globant, we are working to make the world a better place, one step at a time. We enhance business development and enterprise solutions to prepare them for a digital future. With a diverse and talented team present in more than 36 countries, we are strategic partners to leading global companies in their business process transformation.
   

  

 We seek an
 **Expert\-Level Python Open AI** 
 who shares our passion for innovation and change. This role is critical to helping our business partners evolve and adapt to consumers' personalized expectations in this new technological era.
   

  

 Experience: 12 years\- 18 Years
   

  

**Mandatory Skills:** 
 React Native architecture, JavaScript (ES6\+) and Typescript
   

  

**Good to have experience :** 
 Presales,Proposales, RFP
   

  

 We are seeking a highly experienced and passionate Subject Matter Expert (SME) in React Native to join our dynamic product development team.Ideally the candidate should be 10\-15 years at least working with Mobile applications. Strong foundation in mobile development, architecture patterns and DevOps practices.
   

  

 Responsibilities \-
   

  

* Provide expert\-level guidance on React Native architecture, best practices, and performance optimization.
* Design and implement scalable, maintainable, and robust mobile application architectures.
* Make critical technical decisions related to technology choices, frameworks, and libraries within the React Native ecosystem.
* A minimum of 6\-7 years of React Native Experience.
* They should be experienced and well\-rounded in terms of general solution design and application architecture frameworks and principles.
* They need experience with the concept of Super App/Host App \- at least one of the team needs to lead this architecture design that has proven experience.
* Excellent communication and ensuring design patterns are well communicated across all teams.


 In terms of 5 core technical skills:
   

  

* Strong Command of JavaScript (ES6\+) and Typescript for scalable and maintainable code
* Deep understanding of React fundamentals (hooks, context API, Functional components)
* Mobile App Architecture and performance optimisation
* Understanding of lazy loading, memory management, reducing re\-renders etc…
* React native bridges and their optimal development
* Experience integration 3rd party SDKs, APIs, and Libraries (Firebase etc..)
* Security \& State Management
* Implementing Secure AuthN (OAuth, JWT etc..)
* Understanding of security, secure enclaves, local biometrics and the react native integrations for the same
* Encryption, cert pinning, obfuscation
* Managing complex app states using redux, recoil, mobx, and context API of similar technologies, efficiency is key.
* Understands and can manage pipeline/build, and app deployment considerations in a React Native world
* App signing, versioning,Automated testing (all disciplines within),Handling of App Store \& Google Play Store, including OTA updates etc.


 Bonus Points: Contributions to open\-source React Native projects.
   

  

 Good to Have :AI: Github co\-pilot, Coda, Context Engineering, AI Native development
   

  

 Create with us digital products that people love. We will bring businesses and consumers together through AI technology and creativity, driving digital transformation to impact the world positively.
   

  

*We may use AI and machine learning technologies in our recruitment process.* 
 Globant is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Globant is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.
   

  

 Final compensation offered is based on multiple factors such as the specific role, hiring location, as well as individual skills, experience, and qualifications. In addition to competitive salaries, we offer a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about life at Globant here: Globant Experience Guide.

title: Software Engr II
description:
**Job Description**
 As an Advanced V\&V Engineer here at Honeywell, you will develop verification and validation strategies, influence product development, mentor teams, and ensure compliance with regulatory standards
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Key responsibilities:**
* Develop and maintain full stack applications using React and .NET CORE, ensuring high performance and responsiveness.
* Collaborate with UX/UI designers to implement user\-friendly interfaces and improve overall user experience.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to team knowledge sharing to enhance software quality.
* Implement responsive UIs with React that meet our customers' needs and are well\-integrated with the backend services.
* Collaborate with product management and other stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions


**Qualifications**
**YOU MUST HAVE**
* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline such as science, technology, engineering, mathematics.
* 4\+ years of experience in front\-end development with a focus on React.
* Strong understanding of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Experience with state management libraries such as Redux or Context API.
* Familiarity with RESTful APIs and modern front\-end build pipelines and tools.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure DevOps, Azure Functions, and Azure SQL Database.
* Knowledge of modern front\-end build pipelines and tools.
* Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git.
* Experience with database technologies such as SQL Server, Entity Framework, and NoSQL databases.
* Understanding microservices architecture and containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.


**WE VALUE**
* Advanced degree in Computer Science or related field.
* Experience working in Agile development environments.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team\-oriented environment.
* Passion for learning new technologies and staying updated with industry trends


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.
